_comment: Sentinel probe: no macOS host paths may exist in the guest. The guest ships its own userland (threat model section 12, asset AS-1); a visible /Users, /System, /Library, /Volumes or /Applications means host filesystem state leaked across TB1/TB2 without a share.

process.commandLine: leak=0; for d in /Users /System /Library /Volumes /Applications; do if [ -e "$d" ]; then echo "HOSTPATH_PRESENT_LEAK $d"; leak=1; fi; done; if [ "$leak" = 0 ]; then echo HOSTPATH_ABSENT_OK; fi
